acceptance: On a branch that adds a test containing a non-existent '_project/scripts/<x>.json' sample path, make pr-preflight fails and names the project-reference guard.
On a branch that adds 'docs/guide.md' to a test or code file without regenerating the inventory, make pr-preflight fails and names docs-reference-inventory-check.
A change that touches neither code, tests nor docs does not pay for these checks, and pr-preflight wall time on a typical code PR grows by under 10 seconds.
uv run -- pytest -q tests/unit/scripts/test_preflight_targets.py passes, with new cases for the selection, if that route is chosen.
Decision gate: making the inventory scanner treat '\.' as '.' would change its semantics for every file, so choose that only if the owner agrees; the default is to document the pitfall.
description:
Problem. On #4039, make pr-preflight passed at a head that CI then failed twice.
(1) tests/unit/scripts/test_doc_reference_inventory.py::test_committed_inventory_is_current_and_fully_dispositioned failed. A test added the sample path docs/guide.md, and code named docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger\.md as a regex-escaped literal. The inventory scanner records both as references (the escaped one as unresolved), so quality/docs-reference-inventory.json went stale. A plain literal resolves and needs no inventory change.
(2) The lint job's guard-project-references (_project/scripts/check_project_references.py) failed on a new test sample path, _project/scripts/data/table.json, which does not exist.
_project/scripts/preflight_targets.py selects neither test for the changed paths, and pr-preflight does not run either guard. Both are only seen after push.

Change. Have pr-preflight run make docs-reference-inventory-check and _project/scripts/check_project_references.py (both take a few seconds) whenever a changed path is code, a test or a doc. Alternatively, have preflight_targets select test_doc_reference_inventory.py and test_check_project_references.py for those paths. Add one line to the inventory's documentation noting that a regex-escaped path in code is recorded as an unresolved reference.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate; re-read cited files on current origin/develop first.
